states:
Router order matters — first match wins. All in `apps-sdk/ui/src/entries/passkey-onboard.tsx`.

**1. LOADING** — trigger: `!toolOutput` (`:164`). Neither the host tool-result nor a poll has landed. Renders `<DexterLoading eyebrow="DEXTER · PASSKEY WALLET">` with three time-escalating copy stages (`:169-184`): <3s "Checking your wallet status…" / <8s "Resolving session bindings…" / ∞ "Still working — one more moment." No `Header`.

**2. user_not_paired** — trigger: `vault_status === 'user_not_paired'` (`:198`). LinkGlyph, "Link your Dexter account first". Two sub-states:
  - `pairing_url` truthy → "Sign in on dexter.cash" CTA (`onTapPair`) + `<PairingCountdown>` (`:211-220`)
  - `pairing_url` falsy → red error box "Couldn't mint a sign-in link. Refresh the chat and try again." (`:222`)
  **⚠ THIS STATE IS UNREACHABLE.** `grep -rn user_not_paired` over the repo shows the string exists only in the renderer (`:37,:193,:197,:198`), in a server COMMENT (`open-mcp-server.mjs:2104`), and as an internal throw message in `lib/user-scoped-fetch.mjs:54` that is never converted to a `vault_status`. No code path in `dexter_passkey` emits it.

**3. error** — trigger: `vault_status === 'error'` (`:230`). ErrorGlyph, "Couldn't load wallet status", `toolOutput.error` in a red box (fallback string "Unexpected error reading vault status."), secondary "Try again" button calling `callTool('dexter_passkey', {})` (`:245`). Server emits this ONLY on the legacy Supabase-bound path: `open-mcp-server.mjs:2169` (dexter-api non-2xx) and `:2225` (fetch threw). The modern durable-pairing path swallows its failures and falls through to not_enrolled (`open-mcp-server.mjs:2302-2305`).

**4. ready** — trigger: `vault_status === 'ready'` (`:255`). CheckGlyph in a green-bordered disc, green radial wash. Sub-states:
  - `welcome_name` truthy → heading "Welcome, {name} — your wallet's ready"; falsy → "Your wallet's ready" (`:267-269`)
  - `swig_address` truthy → address block: label "Your wallet address", mono `<code>`, `CopyButton`, two text links "Manage your wallet" (`openLink('https://dexter.cash/wallet')`) and "View on Solscan" (`openLink('https://solscan.io/account/{swig}')`) (`:270-294`). Falsy → whole block omitted, leaving heading + prompt + status only.
  - `confettiArmed` → one-shot `ConfettiBurst` (`:263`). Armed once per MOUNT via `firedConfettiRef` (`:97-100`), so a user who opens the widget already-ready still gets it.
  - Always: dashed accent "next" box with italic "Ask me to research a token or pay for an API." (`:295-299`), and a green-dot "vault active" footer (`:300-303`).

**5. provisioning** — trigger: `vault_status === 'provisioning'` (`:310`). KeyGlyph + orbiting amber dot spinner, amber radial wash, "Setting up your wallet" / "This takes a few seconds.", secondary CTA "Resume on dexter.cash" (`onTapEnroll`), then `<PollStatus>`.

**6. not_enrolled (default fallback)** — everything else (`:339-360`). KeyGlyph + pulsing accent ring, accent radial wash. Split by `awaiting_ceremony`:
  - `awaiting_ceremony !== true` → heading "Set up your wallet", supporting "Open dexter.cash to create it with your passkey.", primary CTA "Set up wallet on dexter.cash" (`onTapEnroll`)
  - `awaiting_ceremony === true` → heading "Finish in the other tab", supporting "Complete the passkey step in the tab that opened. This updates when you're done.", **CTA hidden entirely** (`:352`)
  - `<PollStatus polling={polling || awaiting}>` in both.

**Cross-cutting sub-states**:
- `PollStatus` visible whenever `polling` is true (or `awaiting` in state 6). Never appears in ready/error/unpaired.
- `CopyButton` label "Copy" ⇄ "Copied" (2000ms).
- `PairingCountdown` "expires in M:SS" vs `--expired` variant (red border + "expired", value hidden).

**POLLING LOOP** (`:109-143`):
- Interval `POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 1500` (`:21`).
- Started by: `onTapEnroll` (`:149`), `onTapPair` (`:157`), or the auto-start effect when `awaiting_ceremony` is true (`:103-106`).
- Stopped by: the effect at `:91-102` the moment `vault_status === 'ready'` (also arms confetti).
- Each tick calls `callToolRef.current('dexter_passkey', {})`, reads `res.result` (a JSON string), `JSON.parse`es it, and only accepts it if `typeof parsed.vault_status === 'string'` (`:122-133`). The parsed payload is stored in `polledOutput`, which takes precedence: `const toolOutput = polledOutput ?? hostToolOutput` (`:73`). This override exists because widget-initiated `callTool` does NOT refresh `useToolOutput` — that was the original forever-poll bug (comment `:66-71`).
- Both the parse and the call are wrapped in silent `catch {}` (`:130`, `:134`).

**CTA / ui-open-link wiring**:
- `onTapEnroll` (`:145-151`) → `openLink(toolOutput?.enroll_url || ENROLL_URL)` where `ENROLL_URL = 'https://dexter.cash/wallet/setup-passkey'` (`:22`), then `setOpenedAt(Date.now())` + start polling.
- `onTapPair` (`:153-159`) → `openLink(toolOutput.pairing_url)` (no-ops if falsy), same side effects.
- Ready-state links call `openLink` directly inline (`:281`, `:288`).
- `openLink` (`apps-sdk/ui/src/sdk/mcp-apps-bridge.ts:221-225`) sends JSON-RPC `ui/open-link` `{url}` to `window.parent` and falls back to `window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')` if the host rejects.

Type declared at `apps-sdk/ui/src/entries/passkey-onboard.tsx:40-57`. Server builds the object in five places inside `open-mcp-server.mjs:2113-2331`.

| Field | Type | Consumed at | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vault_status` | `'not_enrolled' \| 'provisioning' \| 'ready' \| 'user_not_paired' \| 'error'` | `:191` (router), `:127` (poll guard) | Server only ever emits 4 of the 5 — `user_not_paired` is never produced. |
| `swig_address` | `string \| null` | `:257`, rendered `:274`, copy `:275`, Solscan `:288` | The address the user sees. Server: `open-mcp-server.mjs:2206` (legacy) / `:2263` (durable). |
| `enroll_url` | `string \| undefined` | `:146` (`onTapEnroll`) | Legacy path = `https://dexter.cash/wallet/setup-passkey?mcp=<sessionId>`. Durable path = `minted?.loginUrl \|\| null` (`:2293`) and **`null` on provisioning/ready** (`:2264`, `:2275`). |
| `welcome_name` | `string \| null` | `:258`, heading `:268` | From `deriveWelcomeName(binding.email)` — **only on the legacy Supabase branch** (`:2212`). Durable branch hardcodes `null` (`:2266`). |
| `error` | `string \| null` | `:240` | |
| `awaiting_ceremony` | `boolean \| undefined` | `:103` (auto-poll), `:339`, copy `:348-350`, CTA gate `:352`, `:357` | Emitted ONLY by the durable not_enrolled branch (`:2298`). Absent from every other payload. |
| `pairing_url` | `string \| null` | `:199`, `:154` | **Consumed only inside the dead `user_not_paired` branch → effectively DROPPED.** Server emits it on not_enrolled (`:2295`). |
| `pairing_minted_at` | `number \| null` (epoch ms) | `:217` → `PairingCountdown` | **DROPPED in practice** (dead branch). Server DOES emit it on not_enrolled (`:2296`). |
| `pairing_ttl_seconds` | `number \| null` | `:218` → `PairingCountdown` | **DROPPED in practice.** Server: `Math.floor(VAULT_PAIRING_MAX_AGE_MS / 1000)` = **900** (`open-mcp-server.mjs:2297`, `:2598`). |
| `vault_address` | `string \| null` | `:256` — assigned to `const vault`, **then never referenced** | **DROPPED.** Server always emits it (the vault PDA, `:2205`/`:2262`). Nothing renders it. |
| `user_bound` | `boolean` | — | **DROPPED.** Never read by the renderer. Server emits on every payload. |

**`_meta`**: the tool attaches `PASSKEY_ONBOARD_META` (`open-mcp-server.mjs:143`, built by `widgetMeta()` at `:116-134`) to every response. The renderer **never calls `useToolResponseMetadata`**, so no side-channel token is available here — contrast the wallet, which reads `dexterCardToken` / `dexterWalletToken` (`apps-sdk/ui/src/entries/x402-wallet.tsx:24-26`). If a restyle needs a frame-only capability (reveal rails etc.), it has to be added to both sides.

**Fields the payload does NOT carry** (so don't design for them): balances, USDC amount, credit line, activation state, device label, enrolledAt, onchain data. `fetchVaultStateBySession` returns richer `{status, vault, onchain, ...}` (`lib/pairing-mint.mjs:157-177`) but `dexter_passkey` projects it down to the 11 fields above.

bugs:
**1. [CRITICAL — kills the polling loop on the exact surface Branch tests] Wrong callTool hook: the widget uses the ChatGPT-only one.**
`apps-sdk/ui/src/entries/passkey-onboard.tsx:12` imports `useCallToolFn`, whose body is:
```js
if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.openai?.callTool) { throw new Error("callTool is not available"); }
```
(`apps-sdk/ui/src/sdk/use-call-tool.ts:61-68`; verified byte-for-byte in the SHIPPED bundle `public/apps-sdk/assets/use-call-tool-m-cVfJNn.js`). On Claude (web/desktop/iOS) `window.openai` is undefined — `detectHost()` returns `'mcp-apps'` precisely because `window.self !== window.top` (`apps-sdk/ui/src/sdk/adapter.ts:18-24`), and nothing anywhere in the repo assigns `window.openai` (grepped, zero hits). So **every poll tick throws instantly and is swallowed by the empty `catch {}` at `:134-136`**. The widget shows the amber "watching for completion" dot forever and never flips to ready; the user must re-ask in chat. The fix is a one-line import swap to `useAdaptiveCallToolFn` (`adapter.ts:178-188`), which routes to `mcpApps.callTool` → `tools/call` over postMessage. Note this also means commit 9061e1d ("consume poll result") never took effect on MCP Apps hosts.

**2. [CRITICAL, same root cause] The error state's "Try again" button does nothing, and leaks an unhandled rejection.**
`:245` — `onClick={() => void callTool('dexter_passkey', {})}`. `void` does not attach a catch, so on Claude this produces an unhandled promise rejection in the iframe and zero UI feedback. Same fix.

**3. [HIGH] `polledOutput` is set but never cleared — it permanently masks host updates.**
`:73` `const toolOutput = polledOutput ?? hostToolOutput`. `setPolledOutput` is called at `:128` and there is no reset anywhere. Once the widget has polled successfully even once, a fresh user-initiated `dexter_passkey` tool result (which updates `hostToolOutput`) can never reach the render. Failure: user taps enroll → one poll returns `not_enrolled` → user finishes the ceremony in the other tab → asks Claude "check my wallet" → host pushes `ready` → widget still renders `not_enrolled`. (Latent today only because bug #1 stops the poll from ever succeeding on Claude; it bites the moment #1 is fixed, and bites on ChatGPT now.)

**4. [HIGH] The `user_not_paired` branch is unreachable dead code — and it takes the only pairing countdown with it.**
`:198-227`. No code path in `dexter_passkey` sets `vault_status: 'user_not_paired'` (the string appears in the repo only in this renderer, in a stale server comment at `open-mcp-server.mjs:2104`, and as an unrelated internal `throw` in `lib/user-scoped-fetch.mjs:54`). Consequence: `PairingCountdown` (`:419-448`), `onTapPair` (`:153`), `LinkGlyph`, and the payload's `pairing_url` / `pairing_minted_at` / `pairing_ttl_seconds` are all dead — **even though the server actively emits minted-at and TTL on the `not_enrolled` payload** (`open-mcp-server.mjs:2295-2297`). The user never sees that their sign-in link expires.

**5. [HIGH] `awaiting_ceremony` is a dead end: no CTA, a stuck counter, and (per bug 1) no working poll.**
`:352` hides the button entirely when `awaiting_ceremony` is true, and `:357` passes `openedAt` which is `null` unless the user personally tapped a CTA this mount — so `PollStatus` computes `elapsed = 0` forever (`:410`) and renders "watching for completion · 0s" indefinitely. A user who closed the other tab has no button, a frozen timer, and a poll that can't fire.

**6. [MED] Resume/enroll CTAs silently degrade to an unbound URL.**
`onTapEnroll` (`:146`) falls back to bare `ENROLL_URL = 'https://dexter.cash/wallet/setup-passkey'` (no `?mcp=` / no pairing token) whenever `enroll_url` is null. The durable-pairing branch sets `enroll_url: null` on **provisioning** (`open-mcp-server.mjs:2275`) and on not_enrolled whenever the mint throws (`:2287-2293`). So "Resume on dexter.cash" on the modern path opens a page that cannot bind back to the MCP session.

**7. [MED] Stale comment + unused constant contradicting server ground truth.**
`:23-26`: comment says "Pairing URLs from connector OAuth expire 10 minutes after mint" and `const PAIRING_TTL_SECONDS = 10 * 60`. The server's real value is `VAULT_PAIRING_MAX_AGE_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000` (`open-mcp-server.mjs:2598`, emitted as 900s at `:2297`). The constant is also never referenced anywhere in the file.

**8. [MED] `--dx-ease-out` is undefined → the CTA has no transition at all.**
`passkey-onboard.css:195`: `transition: transform 160ms var(--dx-ease-out), background 160ms var(--dx-ease-out);`. `base.css` defines only `--dx-ease-standard` (`:104`) and `--dx-ease-emphasized` (`:105`). An unresolvable `var()` makes the declaration invalid-at-computed-value-time, so `transition` falls back to its initial value and the hover lift/color change snap. Same bug exists in `styles/widgets/x402-search.css:325,351,353,611,741` and `styles/components/x402gle-lockup.css:62`.

**9. [LOW] `vault_address` is read into a dead variable.**
`:256` `const vault = toolOutput.vault_address || '';` — never referenced again. The vault PDA is fetched, shipped over the wire on every payload, and thrown away.

**10. [LOW] Confetti is clipped by its own container.**
`.dx-passkey__confetti` sets `overflow: visible` (`passkey-onboard.css:368`) but its parent `.dx-passkey__stage` sets `overflow: hidden` (`:51`). Pieces travel up to ~136px out plus a 60px fall (`passkey-onboard.tsx:459`, `passkey-onboard.css:397`) and get cut off at the stage border.

**11. [LOW] Dead CSS**: `.dx-passkey__next-eyebrow` (`passkey-onboard.css:342-349`) — no JSX renders that class.
must_preserve: **Height / iOS sizing — the most fragile thing here.** - `import '../sdk'` at `passkey-onboard.tsx:11` MUST survive the restyle. It triggers `initMcpAppsOnce()` (`adapter.ts:65-67`) → `mcpApps.initialize()` → `ui/initialize` handshake with `protocolVersion: '2026-01-26'`, `appCapabilities.availableDisplayModes: ['inline']`, `appInfo`, then `ui/notifications/initialized`, then `startSizeChangedNotifications()` (`mcp-apps-bridge.ts:130-152`). Drop it and the iframe renders at height 0 — the file comment at `:7-10` documents this exact past failure. - Height on Claude comes SOLELY from `startSizeChangedNotifications` (`mcp-apps-bridge.ts:159-201`): a `ResizeObserver` on both `documentElement` and `body`, rAF-throttled, that **temporarily sets `root.style.width='fit-content'` and `height='max-content'`**, measures `getBoundingClientRect()`, restores, and posts `ui/notifications/size-changed {width, height}` only when the numbers change. Design implications: (a) never use `100vh`, `height: 100%`, or `position: fixed` — the probe will measure garbage; (b) a full-bleed `width: 100%` root measures unpredictably under the `fit-content` probe, so an explicit `max-width` (the wallet's `390px` + `margin: 0 auto`) is strictly safer; (c) absolutely-positioned overlays (confetti, pulse ring, spinner) correctly do NOT grow the document — keep any new decorative layer absolutely positioned; (d) every state flip that changes content height (the ready address block appearing) legitimately fires a new size-changed — that is the intended growth path, don't animate the container's height in a way that spams it. - This widget does NOT call `useIntrinsicHeight` / `notifyIntrinsicHeight`, so it reports no height to ChatGPT at all. If the designer wants parity with the wallet, add both (`entries/x402-wallet.tsx:28-29`) — but that's an addition, not a preservation requirement. **Behavior that must not break** - The `polledOutput ?? hostToolOutput` precedence (`:73`) and the poll's parse-the-return-value contract (`:122-133`). Widget-initiated `callTool` does NOT refresh `useToolOutput`; reverting to host-output-only reintroduces the forever-poll bug. - 1500ms poll cadence (`:21`), auto-stop on `ready` (`:91-102`), auto-start on `awaiting_ceremony` (`:103-106`), and the `firedConfettiRef` per-mount one-shot gate (`:97-100`) — a user resuming an already-provisioned session is supposed to still get the celebration. - All external navigation goes through `openLink()` (`mcp-apps-bridge.ts:221-225`), never a bare `` or `window.open`. It sends `ui/open-link` and only falls back to `window.open` on host rejection. Four call sites: `:147`, `:155`, `:281`, `:288`. - `CopyButton`'s `document.execCommand('copy')` fallback (`:383-390`) — the iOS webview path. - `prefers-reduced-motion` handling: confetti hidden entirely (`passkey-onboard.css:401-405`), pulse/spinner/dot animations killed (`:458-464`), plus the global `*` clamp at `base.css:214-220`. - Mount id `passkey-onboard-root` and the html filename — both are pinned build inputs (`vite.config.ts:70`, `register.mjs:650`). **CSP — the page is sandboxed and the policy is frozen.** Built by `buildWidgetCsp()` at `apps-sdk/register.mjs:83-160`, emitted both tool-side (`open-mcp-server.mjs:129`) and resource-side (`register.mjs:673-681`). `resource_domains` includes `https://dexter.cash` (via the asset-base origin at `register.mjs:96-101` plus `widgetDomain`), which is why the wordmark `` loads. **No external font CDN, no Google Fonts, no new image host** without editing `buildWidgetCsp` — and the header comment at `register.mjs:77` states the CSP freezes at the OpenAI submission scan. `"Inter"` and `"JetBrains Mono"` are referenced as plain family names with system fallbacks; keep it that way (the wallet does the same). **Namespace hygiene**: `sdk.css` pulls in Tailwind's preflight AND `@openai/apps-sdk-ui/css` globally (`sdk.css:6-7`). The wallet defends against this with a `.dxw-`-prefixed namespace plus a `:where(.dxw-root) button` element-specificity reset (`wallet.css:22-27`). notes:
**The three states in the brief are not the three states in the code.** The renderer routes six ways (loading, user_not_paired, error, ready, provisioning, not_enrolled) with three additional sub-state splits (`awaiting_ceremony`, `swig_address` present/absent, `welcome_name` present/absent). Design for **6 real + 3 variants**, minus the dead `user_not_paired` (bug #4) — so realistically: loading / not_enrolled / awaiting-ceremony / provisioning / ready / error, with ready having a no-address degenerate form.

**Two server branches produce materially different payloads for the same status.** `open-mcp-server.mjs` Branch 1 (`:2126-2243`, legacy Supabase-bound) is the only one that ever supplies `welcome_name`, and the only one that can produce `vault_status: 'error'`. Branch 2 (`:2254-2306`, durable vault pairing — restart-proof, what claude.ai/iOS actually uses today) always sends `welcome_name: null` and `enroll_url: null` on ready/provisioning, and is the only source of `awaiting_ceremony` + the pairing timestamps. **So on Branch's iOS test surface, the "Welcome, {name}" headline is unreachable and the error state is unreachable.** If the designer builds a beautiful named-welcome moment, it will never fire without a server change at `:2266`.

**Shared-component opportunity (and a live drift risk).** `x402_wallet` already renders a cream-paper "Set up your wallet" card with a passkey CTA pointing at the same `dexter.cash/wallet/setup-passkey` URL — `components/wallet/SimpleState.tsx` invoked from `entries/x402-wallet.tsx:36-45`. The passkey widget's `not_enrolled` state is the same moment in the same product. Restyling passkey-onboard with a second hand-rolled version of that card is exactly the bypass drift Branch flags. Recommend: promote `SimpleState` + `Lockup` (+ the `dxw-` token block) into a shared surface both entries import, rather than copying `.dxw-*` rules into `passkey-onboard.css`.

**`DexterLoading` is shared with x402 search.** `components/loading/DexterLoading.tsx` is used by both the passkey loader and the marketplace loader (its own docblock says so, `:37-40`), styled by `styles/components/dexter-loading.css` which is built on the dark `--dx-*` tokens. Restyling it to cream will change the search widget too. Either (a) parameterize it, (b) fork a passkey-specific loading view, or (c) accept that both move together — but decide deliberately, it's a two-widget blast radius.

**Both external images resolve** (verified live): `https://dexter.cash/wordmarks/dexter-wordmark.svg` → 200 `image/svg+xml`, and `DexterLoading`'s default `https://dexter.cash/assets/pokedexter/dexter-logo.svg` → 200 `image/svg+xml`.
